C0281.title: A data exfiltration and remote exploitation attack on consumer 3D printers
C0281.summary: This research reveals data exfiltration and remote exploitation attacks targeting consumer-grade 3D printers. The study found that the printers store data of printed and in-progress objects on an unauthenticated web server, and flaws in the transport layer security implementation allow sensitive intellectual property data to be remotely stolen and manipulated.

references.title: A Data Exfiltration and Remote Exploitation Attack on Consumer 3D Printers
